obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep written risk strategies and limit systems with clear lines of responsibility
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kreditinstitute-Risikomanagementverordnung (KI-RMV), BGBl. II Nr. 487/2013, § 3 Abs. 2 bis 8, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep written risk strategies and limit systems with clear lines of responsibility

summaries.en: A credit institution must have a transparent division of tasks and responsibilities that avoids conflicts of interest and of competence, and written, coherent risk strategies and limit systems that can be traced back to its general business strategy. It must review and update its risk procedures regularly, make sure the data they use are consistent and valid, document the measures it takes, cover the risk of its own business model and take the results of internal stress tests into account.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Grant credit on sound, defined criteria and assess credit risk with internal methods
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kreditinstitute-Risikomanagementverordnung (KI-RMV), BGBl. II Nr. 487/2013, § 5 Abs. 1 bis 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Grant credit on sound, defined criteria and assess credit risk with internal methods

summaries.en: A credit institution must grant credit on sound, clearly defined criteria and set out in writing how credits are approved, changed, extended and refinanced. It must have internal methods for assessing credit risk per debtor and for the whole portfolio that do not rely solely or automatically on external ratings, effective systems for monitoring its credit portfolios, for identifying and managing problem loans and for value adjustments and provisions, and a credit portfolio that is adequately diversified.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify and manage concentration risks under written policies and procedures
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kreditinstitute-Risikomanagementverordnung (KI-RMV), BGBl. II Nr. 487/2013, § 7, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Identify and manage concentration risks under written policies and procedures

summaries.en: A credit institution must use written policies and procedures to identify and manage its concentration risks, in particular towards single counterparties and groups of connected counterparties, towards counterparties in the same sector or region, from credit risk mitigation, from large indirect credit exposures, in its investments and funding sources, and from correlated risk factors.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Measure and manage all material market risks and cover them with internal capital
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kreditinstitute-Risikomanagementverordnung (KI-RMV), BGBl. II Nr. 487/2013, § 9 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Measure and manage all material market risks and cover them with internal capital

summaries.en: A credit institution must have policies and procedures to identify, measure and manage all material sources and effects of market risk, and measures against a liquidity shortfall where a short position falls due before the long position. Its internal capital must adequately cover material market risks that carry no own funds requirement.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Manage operational risk and keep tested contingency and business continuity plans
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kreditinstitute-Risikomanagementverordnung (KI-RMV), BGBl. II Nr. 487/2013, § 11 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Manage operational risk and keep tested contingency and business continuity plans

summaries.en: A credit institution must apply suitable policies and procedures to assess and manage its operational risks, model risk and outsourcing risk included, analyse the causes of significant losses and document the results. It must have adequate contingency and business continuity policies and plans, including the ICT continuity and recovery plans of Article 11 of Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, and see that they are set up, maintained and tested so that it can keep operating in a severe disruption.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run liquidity risk strategies, limits and buffers across time horizons including intraday
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kreditinstitute-Risikomanagementverordnung (KI-RMV), BGBl. II Nr. 487/2013, § 12 Abs. 1 bis 8, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Run liquidity risk strategies, limits and buffers across time horizons including intraday

summaries.en: A credit institution must have strategies, policies, procedures and systems to identify, measure, manage, monitor and limit liquidity risk over an appropriate set of time horizons, intraday included, so that it holds adequate liquidity buffers. They must fit its complexity, risk profile and the risk tolerance set by the management body, allocate liquidity costs, benefits and risks, track funding positions and asset encumbrance, and be backed by limit systems, buffers and a sufficiently diversified funding structure that are reviewed regularly.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Stress test liquidity and keep a liquidity contingency plan approved by the management body
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kreditinstitute-Risikomanagementverordnung (KI-RMV), BGBl. II Nr. 487/2013, § 12 Abs. 9 bis 12, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Stress test liquidity and keep a liquidity contingency plan approved by the management body

summaries.en: A credit institution must run stress tests of its liquidity positions and risk mitigants, off-balance-sheet items included, review the underlying assumptions at least once a year and adjust its liquidity strategies, policies and limits to the results. It must draw up effective contingency plans with concrete measures and quantified in- and outflows for a liquidity crisis, review them at least once a year, implement and test the operational steps in advance, and have the management body approve the plans and their updates.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify, manage and monitor the risk of excessive leverage
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kreditinstitute-Risikomanagementverordnung (KI-RMV), BGBl. II Nr. 487/2013, § 13 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Identify, manage and monitor the risk of excessive leverage

summaries.en: A credit institution must have policies and procedures to identify, manage and monitor the risk of excessive leverage, using at least the leverage ratio under Article 429 of the Capital Requirements Regulation and mismatches between assets and liabilities as indicators. It must monitor the risk in advance, allow for the fall in own funds that expected or realised losses can cause, and be able to withstand a range of stress situations.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold eligible capital for qualifying holdings outside the financial sector beyond the limits
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), CRR-Begleitverordnung 2021 (CRR-BV 2021), BGBl. II Nr. 542/2021, § 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Hold eligible capital for qualifying holdings outside the financial sector beyond the limits

summaries.en: Where the limits of Article 89(1) or (2) of the Capital Requirements Regulation for qualifying holdings outside the financial sector are exceeded, an institution must hold eligible capital in the amount of the holdings beyond those limits. Where both limits are exceeded, only the larger excess counts.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Treat a past due obligation as material above 1 per cent and 100 or 500 euros
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), CRR-Begleitverordnung 2021 (CRR-BV 2021), BGBl. II Nr. 542/2021, § 4 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Treat a past due obligation as material above 1 per cent and 100 or 500 euros

summaries.en: For the definition of default an institution must treat an obligation as material in any case where, for more than 90 consecutive days, the debtor's overdue amounts exceed 1 per cent of all on-balance-sheet exposures to that debtor and also exceed 100 euros for retail exposures or 500 euros for other exposures. An institution that applies the default definition per credit facility measures both figures on the single facility.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use the equity method for prudential consolidation of financial holdings unless full or proportional consolidation applies
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), CRR-Begleitverordnung 2021 (CRR-BV 2021), BGBl. II Nr. 542/2021, § 6 Abs. 1 bis 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Use the equity method for prudential consolidation of financial holdings unless full or proportional consolidation applies

summaries.en: An institution must also use the equity method for prudential consolidation of participations in credit institutions, financial institutions and asset management companies that its accounts include at equity and that are not otherwise within consolidated supervision, unless the competent authority requires proportional or full consolidation. It must consolidate in full where it bears most of the risks or enjoys most of the benefits of the entity's relevant activities, and proportionally where the owners have agreed, or would clearly act, to support the entity together in line with their shares.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply a countercyclical buffer rate of 0 per cent to Austrian exposures and cap foreign rates at 2.5 per cent
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kapitalpuffer-Verordnung 2025 (KP-V 2025), BGBl. II Nr. 112/2025, § 4 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Apply a countercyclical buffer rate of 0 per cent to Austrian exposures and cap foreign rates at 2.5 per cent

summaries.en: When it calculates its countercyclical capital buffer a credit institution must apply a rate of 0 per cent to its material credit exposures located in Austria. Where the authority of another member state or of a third country has set a rate above 2.5 per cent for its country, the institution uses 2.5 per cent for its material credit exposures there.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold the buffer for systemically important institutions at the rate set for the institution
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kapitalpuffer-Verordnung 2025 (KP-V 2025), BGBl. II Nr. 112/2025, § 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Hold the buffer for systemically important institutions at the rate set for the institution

summaries.en: A credit institution named in § 6 must hold the capital buffer for systemically important institutions: the rate § 6 sets for it, between 0.45 and 1.75 per cent, multiplied by its total risk exposure amount under Article 92(3) of the Capital Requirements Regulation. It holds the buffer on a consolidated basis, on an individual basis, or on both, as § 6 names it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold the systemic risk buffer on commercial real estate exposures and at the institution's own rate
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kapitalpuffer-Verordnung 2025 (KP-V 2025), BGBl. II Nr. 112/2025, § 7 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Hold the systemic risk buffer on commercial real estate exposures and at the institution's own rate

summaries.en: A credit institution must calculate its systemic risk buffer under the annex to § 23e BWG with a rate of 2 per cent on the risk-weighted amounts of its commercial real estate exposures located in Austria, on a consolidated and on an individual basis. An institution named in § 8 must in addition hold the rate set for it there, 0.5 or 1 per cent of its total risk exposure amount, on the basis § 8 names.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the asset statement after each quarter by the twentieth banking day
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Vermögens-, Erfolgs- und Risikoausweis-Verordnung (VERA-V), BGBl. II Nr. 471/2006, § 2 Abs. 1 bis 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: File the asset statement after each quarter by the twentieth banking day

summaries.en: A credit institution must send its asset statement, set out as the annexes named in § 1 require, without delay after each calendar quarter: the statement in Anlage A1a by the twentieth banking day of the following month and the one in Anlage A1c by the sixteenth. The statement in Anlage A1d follows each calendar half-year by the twentieth banking day of the following month, and the one in Anlage A1e follows the reporting dates and filing deadlines of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/451.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the income statement after each quarter by the twentieth banking day
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Vermögens-, Erfolgs- und Risikoausweis-Verordnung (VERA-V), BGBl. II Nr. 471/2006, § 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: File the income statement after each quarter by the twentieth banking day

summaries.en: A credit institution must send its income statement, set out as Anlage A2 requires, without delay after each calendar quarter and by the twentieth banking day of the following month at the latest.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report remuneration data by the 15th day of the sixth month after the financial year
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Vermögens-, Erfolgs- und Risikoausweis-Verordnung (VERA-V), BGBl. II Nr. 471/2006, § 6 Abs. 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report remuneration data by the 15th day of the sixth month after the financial year

summaries.en: A credit institution must report the remuneration parts of its risk statement by the 15th day of the sixth month after the financial year: the general pay data and the high earners (Anlagen REMBM and REMHE) every year, the approved higher ratios of variable to fixed pay (Anlage REMHR) every second year and the gender pay gap (Anlage REMGAP) every third year. § 5 lets small and non-complex institutions and institutions with few staff report less.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report complaints handling data once a year by the twentieth banking day
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Vermögens-, Erfolgs- und Risikoausweis-Verordnung (VERA-V), BGBl. II Nr. 471/2006, § 6 Abs. 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report complaints handling data once a year by the twentieth banking day

summaries.en: A credit institution must send the part of its risk statement on complaints handling (Anlage A3g) without delay after each calendar year and by the twentieth banking day after the reporting date at the latest. § 5 counts as a complaint every expression of dissatisfaction that a person addresses to the institution about a banking service, an investment service, a payment service or the issue of e-money.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report private residential real estate financing each quarter by the 45th banking day
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Vermögens-, Erfolgs- und Risikoausweis-Verordnung (VERA-V), BGBl. II Nr. 471/2006, § 6a Abs. 1 und 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report private residential real estate financing each quarter by the 45th banking day

summaries.en: A CRR credit institution established in Austria, and an Austrian branch of one from another member state, must report its private residential real estate financing each quarter on an unconsolidated basis as Anlage H requires. The reporting dates are the last day of March, June, September and December; new financing of the quarter and the stock on the reporting date are reported without delay and by the 45th banking day after that date at the latest.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the group's consolidated asset and income statement within two months of each quarter
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Vermögens-, Erfolgs- und Risikoausweis-Verordnung (VERA-V), BGBl. II Nr. 471/2006, § 8, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: File the group's consolidated asset and income statement within two months of each quarter

summaries.en: The responsible undertaking of a group of credit institutions must send the group's asset and income statement in the form of Anlage B1 without delay after each calendar quarter and within two months of the reporting date at the latest. § 10 lifts the duty while the group's operating result differs from that of the parent institution by no more than 5 per cent, and § 14a where the parent reports under Regulation (EU) 2015/534.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the statements electronically with the Oesterreichische Nationalbank in the standard form
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Vermögens-, Erfolgs- und Risikoausweis-Verordnung (VERA-V), BGBl. II Nr. 471/2006, § 16, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: File the statements electronically with the Oesterreichische Nationalbank in the standard form

summaries.en: A credit institution must file the reports under the regulation in standardised form by electronic transmission to the Oesterreichische Nationalbank. The transmission must meet the minimum requirements the Financial Market Authority announces after hearing the Nationalbank.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the audited annual accounts data electronically within six months of the financial year
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Jahres- und Konzernabschluss-Verordnung (JKAB-V), BGBl. II Nr. 470/2006, § 6 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report the audited annual accounts data electronically within six months of the financial year

summaries.en: A credit institution must report the data of its audited annual accounts, set out as the annexes require, to the Oesterreichische Nationalbank in standardised electronic form without delay and within six months of the end of the financial year at the latest. The transmission must meet the minimum requirements the Financial Market Authority announces; the reports go to the authority itself only when it expressly asks.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set out the audited consolidated accounts data in the prescribed form
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Jahres- und Konzernabschluss-Verordnung (JKAB-V), BGBl. II Nr. 470/2006, § 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Set out the audited consolidated accounts data in the prescribed form

summaries.en: A parent credit institution that draws up consolidated accounts under § 59 BWG must set out the data of its audited consolidated accounts and the other asset and income data as Anlage B1 requires. § 6a lifts the duty for parents that report supervisory financial information under Article 5 of Regulation (EU) 2015/534.

obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Stammdatenmeldungsverordnung 2016 (StDMV 2016), BGBl. II Nr. 371/2016, § 5 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report every change of master data within 20 banking days of its taking effect

summaries.en: A credit institution must report every change to the master data it has to file, company data, risk approaches and holdings, within 20 banking days of the change taking effect, and state the date on which it took effect.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report staff numbers at year end by 31 January
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Stammdatenmeldungsverordnung 2016 (StDMV 2016), BGBl. II Nr. 371/2016, § 5 Abs. 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report staff numbers at year end by 31 January

summaries.en: A credit institution reports its number of staff only as at the end of the year, by 31 January of the following year at the latest. Changes during the year that result from mergers or new foundations must still be reported within 20 banking days of taking effect.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Confirm the stored master data after each half-year
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Stammdatenmeldungsverordnung 2016 (StDMV 2016), BGBl. II Nr. 371/2016, § 7, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Confirm the stored master data after each half-year

summaries.en: After the end of each calendar half-year a credit institution must confirm that its stored master data are correct, by the twenty-fifth banking day of the following half-year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report every direct and indirect holding individually
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Stammdatenmeldungsverordnung 2016 (StDMV 2016), BGBl. II Nr. 371/2016, § 10 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report every direct and indirect holding individually

summaries.en: A credit institution must report its holdings and share rights as Anlage 3 requires and list each directly and indirectly held holding individually by its OeNB identification number. Under § 6 the parent institution of a group, or the central organisation of an association of credit institutions, files this report as a whole for all institutions below it.

obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), FMA-Incoming-Plattformverordnung (FMA-IPV), BGBl. II Nr. 184/2010, § 1 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: File the listed notifications and submissions only through the FMA's Incoming Platform

summaries.en: A firm must make the notifications, transmissions and submissions under the provisions the paragraph lists in electronic form through the Incoming Platform of the Financial Market Authority. The list covers filings under the Banking Act, the Capital Requirements Regulation, the payment, e-money, securities, fund, recovery and resolution, deposit guarantee, covered bond and insurance statutes and Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, among others. Abs. 2 names the cases in which the duty does not apply.
