titles.en: File a significant institution's listed notices through the IMAS Portal

summaries.en: A significant supervised entity must make the notifications under § 9 Abs. 5, § 10 Abs. 2, 5 und 6 and § 25 Abs. 5 BWG in electronic form through the IMAS Portal of the Single Supervisory Mechanism. The same channel applies to the filings under § 28a Abs. 4 and the listed items of § 73 BWG that arise from a change of persons at such an entity.

instruments.title: Add EKV 2016, the FMA's regulation on the information in a qualifying-holding notice (Eigentümerkontrollverordnung 2016)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Eigentümerkontrollverordnung 2016 (EKV 2016), BGBl. II Nr. 425/2015, made by the Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) under § 20b Abs. 3 BWG, § 26 Abs. 3 VAG 2016 and § 11b Abs. 3 WAG 2007 (title document: long title, gazette reference, preamble, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, last amended by BGBl. II Nr. 195/2018; entry into force read in § 16 Abs. 1

titles.de: Verordnung der Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) über die Informationen, die ein Anzeigepflichtiger, der einen Erwerb, eine Erhöhung, eine Aufgabe oder eine Herabsetzung einer qualifizierten Beteiligung an einem Kreditinstitut, an einem Versicherungs- oder Rückversicherungsunternehmen, an einem Wertpapierdienstleistungsunternehmen, an einem Zahlungsinstitut oder an einem E-Geld-Institut beabsichtigt, der FMA vorzulegen hat (Eigentümerkontrollverordnung 2016 – EKV 2016)
titles.en: Regulation of the Financial Market Authority (FMA) on the information to be submitted to the FMA by a person who intends to acquire, increase, give up or reduce a qualifying holding in a credit institution, an insurance or reinsurance undertaking, an investment services undertaking, a payment institution or an e-money institution (Owner Control Regulation 2016)

obligations.title: Add the duty: File a qualifying-holding notice with the FMA on the prescribed form
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Eigentümerkontrollverordnung 2016 (EKV 2016), BGBl. II Nr. 425/2015, § 4 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: File a qualifying-holding notice with the FMA on the prescribed form

summaries.en: A person who notifies the intended acquisition or increase of a qualifying holding must file the notice with the Financial Market Authority on the form in Anlage 1, with the information the second section requires, or for a holding in an investment services undertaking with the information § 7 Abs. 2 lists; a notice of giving up a holding or falling below the statutory thresholds uses the form in Anlage 2. Information that is not in German must come with certified translations unless the authority waives them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Answer for the completeness, accuracy and currency of the information in the notice
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Eigentümerkontrollverordnung 2016 (EKV 2016), BGBl. II Nr. 425/2015, § 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Answer for the completeness, accuracy and currency of the information in the notice

summaries.en: The person who owes the notice is responsible for the completeness, accuracy and currency of the information given in the notice or submitted at the request of the Financial Market Authority.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Declare criminal, administrative and insolvency proceedings in the notice and prove the statements
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Eigentümerkontrollverordnung 2016 (EKV 2016), BGBl. II Nr. 425/2015, § 9 Abs. 1, 2 und 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Declare criminal, administrative and insolvency proceedings in the notice and prove the statements

summaries.en: In the notice the acquirer must state whether criminal investigations or proceedings are or were conducted against it, whether administrative penal proceedings connected with its business are pending or ended with a penalty in the last five years, whether it is or was a debtor in insolvency proceedings, and the further points the paragraph lists. Discontinued proceedings, acquittals and expunged convictions need not be stated. The criminal record statements are proved by a criminal record certificate, the others by official certificates where available.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Show the origin of the funds for the acquisition and disclose all related agreements
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Eigentümerkontrollverordnung 2016 (EKV 2016), BGBl. II Nr. 425/2015, § 13 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Show the origin of the funds for the acquisition and disclose all related agreements

summaries.en: The notice must include a meaningful account of the existence and economic origin of the own and borrowed funds to be used for the acquisition, of all agreements and contracts made in connection with it, of joint action and intended agreements with other holders, and of the purchase price and how it was set. An acquirer of a direct holding also states the market value of the target's shares before and after the acquisition.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Add a business plan when the acquisition gives more than 50 per cent or control
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Eigentümerkontrollverordnung 2016 (EKV 2016), BGBl. II Nr. 425/2015, § 14 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Add a business plan when the acquisition gives more than 50 per cent or control

summaries.en: Where the planned acquisition or increase gives the acquirer more than 50 per cent of the capital or voting rights of the target, or control of it by other means, the notice must include a business plan that describes the strategic aims and plans pursued. The plan covers the planned strategic development, the planned development of assets, finances and earnings, and the effects on the target's corporate and organisational structure.

instruments.title: Add Online-IDV, the FMA's regulation on video-based online identification of customers (Online-Identifikationsverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Online-Identifikationsverordnung (Online-IDV), BGBl. II Nr. 5/2017, made by the Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) under § 6 Abs. 4 FM-GwG (title document: long title, gazette reference, preamble, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, last amended by BGBl. II Nr. 470/2022; entry into force read in the RIS Inkrafttretensdatum of the original title document

titles.de: Verordnung der Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) über die videogestützte Online-Identifikation von Kunden (Online-Identifikationsverordnung – Online-IDV)
titles.en: Regulation of the Financial Market Authority (FMA) on video-based online identification of customers (Online Identification Regulation)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use only trained and reliable staff for online identification, in a closed room with access control
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Online-Identifikationsverordnung (Online-IDV), BGBl. II Nr. 5/2017, § 3 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Use only trained and reliable staff for online identification, in a closed room with access control

summaries.en: A firm may use only employees who are adequately trained, at least in the legal framework, the technical requirements and the practical checks, and reliable for video identification. It must make sure the applications and data used cannot conflict with other processes or be influenced and are protected against unauthorised access, and its employees may carry out the identification only in a separate room with access control.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record the identification call in full and take screenshots of the face and both sides of the identity document
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Online-Identifikationsverordnung (Online-IDV), BGBl. II Nr. 5/2017, § 4 Abs. 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Record the identification call in full and take screenshots of the face and both sides of the identity document

summaries.en: The conversation or the part of it that serves the identification must be recorded acoustically in its entirety. The firm must also take screenshots, of a quality that makes the person and the document data fully and clearly recognisable, of the customer's or representative's face and of the front and back of the official photo identity document or its data page.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Check liveness, the identity document's authenticity and a one-time code during the video call
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Online-Identifikationsverordnung (Online-IDV), BGBl. II Nr. 5/2017, § 4 Abs. 3 bis 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Check liveness, the identity document's authenticity and a one-time code during the video call

summaries.en: During the call the customer must on request move the head and separately state the document's serial number or a random sequence of at least four characters generated by the firm. The employee must check the document's optical and holographic security features by having it tilted, the serial number's format, the intact laminate, that the photo was not added later and the logical consistency of person, photo, dates and existing customer data. The customer must enter and send back a centrally generated number sequence sent to them by e-mail or text message for this identification.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep biometric identification state of the art, documented and limited to electronically signed documents
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Online-Identifikationsverordnung (Online-IDV), BGBl. II Nr. 5/2017, § 4 Abs. 6, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep biometric identification state of the art, documented and limited to electronically signed documents

summaries.en: A firm that identifies customers by a biometric procedure, where Article 9(2)(a) GDPR allows it, must keep the procedure state of the art with a security level at least equal to identification by staff, monitor its integrity actively, document the procedure, the security factors and the results of each check, and keep the recordings as records under § 21 Abs. 1 Z 1 FM-GwG. It must verify the customer's actual presence with a video-based check and use only identity documents whose content the issuing authority signed electronically, verifying the signature, the integrity of the signed data and that no compromised key was used.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Break off the online identification when the checks cannot be made or anything is doubtful
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Online-Identifikationsverordnung (Online-IDV), BGBl. II Nr. 5/2017, § 5 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Break off the online identification when the checks cannot be made or anything is doubtful

summaries.en: The firm must break off the identification where the customer or the document cannot be checked properly with the procedural safeguards, or where there are other inconsistencies or uncertainties. Where § 5 Z 4 or 5 FM-GwG applies, it completes the identification instead and considers filing a suspicious transaction report with the Financial Intelligence Unit under § 16 FM-GwG.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep responsibility and equivalent safeguards when a processor carries out the online identification
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Online-Identifikationsverordnung (Online-IDV), BGBl. II Nr. 5/2017, § 6 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep responsibility and equivalent safeguards when a processor carries out the online identification

summaries.en: A firm that uses a processor for online identification must ensure that the processor applies safeguards equal in scope and quality to those of the regulation, keeps the final responsibility itself, agrees a clear division of rights and duties in writing and acts with due professionalism and care when concluding, running and ending the agreement. Outsourcing may not materially impair the quality of internal control or the authority's ability to check compliance.

instruments.title: Add AndKo-SoV, the FMA's regulation on simplified due diligence for escrow accounts of lawyers, notaries and property managers (Anderkonten-Sorgfaltspflichtenverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Anderkonten-Sorgfaltspflichtenverordnung (AndKo-SoV), BGBl. II Nr. 7/2017, made by the Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) under § 8 Abs. 5 FM-GwG (title document: long title, gazette reference, preamble, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, not amended since the original version; entry into force read in the RIS Inkrafttretensdatum of the original title document

titles.de: Verordnung der Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) über die Anwendbarkeit vereinfachter Sorgfaltspflichten im Bereich der Anderkonten von Rechtsanwälten, Notaren oder Immobilienverwaltern (Anderkonten-Sorgfaltspflichtenverordnung – AndKo-SoV)
titles.en: Regulation of the Financial Market Authority (FMA) on applying simplified due diligence to escrow accounts of lawyers, notaries or property managers (Escrow Accounts Due Diligence Regulation)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep monitoring escrow accounts and their transactions while applying simplified due diligence
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Anderkonten-Sorgfaltspflichtenverordnung (AndKo-SoV), BGBl. II Nr. 7/2017, § 1 Abs. 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep monitoring escrow accounts and their transactions while applying simplified due diligence

summaries.en: A credit institution that applies the simplified due diligence of the regulation to the escrow accounts it lists must still monitor the transactions and business relationships enough to detect unusual or suspicious transactions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not treat an escrow account as low risk where the information available points otherwise
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Anderkonten-Sorgfaltspflichtenverordnung (AndKo-SoV), BGBl. II Nr. 7/2017, § 1 Abs. 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Do not treat an escrow account as low risk where the information available points otherwise

summaries.en: A credit institution may not assume a low money laundering or terrorist financing risk for the listed escrow accounts where the information it holds suggests that the risk is not low; in that case it may not apply the simplified due diligence of the regulation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ask the lawyer or notary for trustor identity details when due diligence needs them
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Anderkonten-Sorgfaltspflichtenverordnung (AndKo-SoV), BGBl. II Nr. 7/2017, § 2 Abs. 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Ask the lawyer or notary for trustor identity details when due diligence needs them

summaries.en: Where a credit institution finds that it needs further information on the identity of the trustors of a pooled, estate, guardianship or insolvency escrow account to meet its due diligence and reporting duties under the FM-GwG, it must request that information from the lawyer or notary for whom the account is kept. § 3 Abs. 2 sets the same duty towards the property manager of an owners' community account.

instruments.title: Add QVV, the FMA's regulation on cross-selling of investment services in packages (Querverkaufsverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Querverkaufsverordnung (QVV), BGBl. II Nr. 394/2017, made by the Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) under § 47 Abs. 5 WAG 2018 (title document: long title, gazette reference, preamble, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, not amended since the original version; entry into force read in § 11

titles.de: Verordnung der Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) zur Konkretisierung der sich für Rechtsträger nach dem WAG 2018 ergebenden Pflichten im Umgang mit Querverkäufen (Querverkaufsverordnung – QVV)
titles.en: Regulation of the Financial Market Authority (FMA) specifying the duties of firms under the WAG 2018 in cross-selling (Cross-Selling Regulation)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give prices for every component and the whole package equally clearly when advertising a package
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Querverkaufsverordnung (QVV), BGBl. II Nr. 394/2017, § 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Give prices for every component and the whole package equally clearly when advertising a package

summaries.en: Where a firm advertises a package by praising one or more of its components and gives prices or ancillary costs, it must give them for every component and for the package itself with the same clarity.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Describe the price and itemised costs of the package and each component in good time before the deal
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Querverkaufsverordnung (QVV), BGBl. II Nr. 394/2017, § 4 Abs. 1 bis 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Describe the price and itemised costs of the package and each component in good time before the deal

summaries.en: For each package a firm must show the price of the package and of each component, with all ancillary costs itemised, administration fees, transaction costs and early termination charges included, estimated on reasonable assumptions where they cannot yet be calculated. The description must reach the client early enough for an informed decision, be clearly visible, precise and plainly worded, and may not mislead, hide costs or prevent a comparison with an alternative product.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Explain how the package's risk profile differs from that of its components
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Querverkaufsverordnung (QVV), BGBl. II Nr. 394/2017, § 5 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Explain how the package's risk profile differs from that of its components

summaries.en: The description must also set out any differences between the risks of the package and those of its components, their interactions and other material features, as visibly as the price description and without misleading or distorting the effect those features and risks have for the client.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not make the package appear compulsory or preselect it
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Querverkaufsverordnung (QVV), BGBl. II Nr. 394/2017, § 6, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Do not make the package appear compulsory or preselect it

summaries.en: Where a firm informs the client that the components can be bought separately, it may not weaken that information by designing the offer so that buying the package seems compulsory, or by preselecting the package when the client chooses between the package and its components.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Design sales staff remuneration so that cross-selling stays fair and free of conflicts
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Querverkaufsverordnung (QVV), BGBl. II Nr. 394/2017, § 7, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Design sales staff remuneration so that cross-selling stays fair and free of conflicts

summaries.en: A firm's remuneration policies and practices under Article 27 of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/565 must also ensure in cross-selling that the firm acts responsibly, treats clients fairly and avoids conflicts of interest.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep every withdrawal right a component has when it is sold in a package
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Querverkaufsverordnung (QVV), BGBl. II Nr. 394/2017, § 8, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep every withdrawal right a component has when it is sold in a package

summaries.en: When bundling or tying products or services into a package, a firm must ensure that every right of withdrawal or cancellation that a component has by law or contract when bought on its own applies equally when it is part of the package.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Design packages so that the client can later split them without disproportionate penalties
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Querverkaufsverordnung (QVV), BGBl. II Nr. 394/2017, § 9 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Design packages so that the client can later split them without disproportionate penalties

summaries.en: A firm must design a package so that its components can be split after the sale into independent contracts without disproportionate contractual penalties or other consequences. The duty does not apply where other applicable law allows a further restriction or objective reasons justify one.

instruments.title: Add FMA-PIV, the FMA's product intervention regulation on binary options and contracts for difference (FMA-Produktinterventionsverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), FMA-Produktinterventionsverordnung (FMA-PIV), BGBl. II Nr. 118/2019, made by the Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) under § 90 Abs. 3 Z 15 with Abs. 8 WAG 2018 and § 4 Abs. 3 und 4 PRIIP-Vollzugsgesetz (title document: long title, gazette reference, preamble, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, not amended since the original version; entry into force read in § 5

titles.de: Verordnung der Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) über Maßnahmen der Produktintervention (FMA-Produktinterventionsverordnung – FMA-PIV)
titles.en: Regulation of the Financial Market Authority (FMA) on product intervention measures (FMA Product Intervention Regulation)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not market, distribute or sell binary options to retail clients unless they meet the exempting conditions
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), FMA-Produktinterventionsverordnung (FMA-PIV), BGBl. II Nr. 118/2019, § 3 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface; applies from the day § 4 states

titles.en: Do not market, distribute or sell binary options to retail clients unless they meet the exempting conditions

summaries.en: A firm may not market, distribute or sell binary options to retail clients unless the lower of the two fixed amounts at least equals the client's total payment including all costs, or the option runs at least 90 days, has an approved public prospectus, exposes the provider to no market risk through hedging and earns the provider and its group nothing beyond the disclosed costs.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Sell contracts for difference to retail clients only with minimum margins, margin close-out and negative balance protection
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), FMA-Produktinterventionsverordnung (FMA-PIV), BGBl. II Nr. 118/2019, § 3 Abs. 2 Z 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface; applies from the day § 4 states

titles.en: Sell contracts for difference to retail clients only with minimum margins, margin close-out and negative balance protection

summaries.en: A firm may market, distribute or sell contracts for difference to retail clients only if it requires the initial margins the paragraph sets, from 3.33 per cent of the notional value for major currency pairs to 50 per cent for virtual currencies. It must close one or more open positions on the best terms for the client when the funds on the CFD account and the unrealised net profits fall below half of the initial margins, and limit the client's total liability to the funds on that account.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give retail clients no incentives to trade contracts for difference and put the prescribed risk warning in every marketing communication
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), FMA-Produktinterventionsverordnung (FMA-PIV), BGBl. II Nr. 118/2019, § 3 Abs. 2 Z 4 und 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface; applies from the day § 4 states

titles.en: Give retail clients no incentives to trade contracts for difference and put the prescribed risk warning in every marketing communication

summaries.en: A firm may not give a retail client any payment or monetary or non-monetary benefit related to marketing or selling contracts for difference, other than realised profits and information and research tools on such contracts. It may send or publish marketing information on contracts for difference that retail clients can see only if it contains the risk warning set out in Anlage 1.

instruments.title: Add TransV 2018, the FMA's regulation on interim reports and major holding notifications (Transparenz-Verordnung 2018)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Transparenz-Verordnung 2018 (TransV 2018), BGBl. II Nr. 392/2017, made by the Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) under § 122 Abs. 10 Z 1 und 5, § 125 Abs. 5 Z 3, § 134 Abs. 5 and § 136 Z 2 bis 6 BörseG 2018 (title document: long title, gazette reference, preamble, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, last amended by BGBl. II Nr. 358/2022; entry into force read in § 20

titles.de: Verordnung der Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) über Inhalte von Zwischenberichten, Meldungen über Änderungen bedeutender Beteiligungen und die Gleichwertigkeit von vorgeschriebenen Informationen aus Drittländern (Transparenz-Verordnung 2018 – TransV 2018)
titles.en: Regulation of the Financial Market Authority (FMA) on the content of interim reports, notifications of changes in major holdings and the equivalence of regulated information from third countries (Transparency Regulation 2018)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give non-IFRS condensed half-year accounts the minimum headings, comparatives and notes
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Transparenz-Verordnung 2018 (TransV 2018), BGBl. II Nr. 392/2017, § 1 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Give non-IFRS condensed half-year accounts the minimum headings, comparatives and notes

summaries.en: An issuer whose condensed half-year accounts are not prepared under IFRS must show in the condensed balance sheet and profit and loss account the headings and subtotals of its last published annual accounts, with additional items where needed for a true and fair view. It adds a balance sheet at the end of the first six months and the previous year end, a profit and loss account for the six months with comparatives, and notes that make the accounts comparable and explain all material changes in the half-year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify the authority within two trading days when relying on the market maker exemption
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Transparenz-Verordnung 2018 (TransV 2018), BGBl. II Nr. 392/2017, § 3 Abs. 1 und 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Notify the authority within two trading days when relying on the market maker exemption

summaries.en: A market maker that wants to use the exemption in § 130 Abs. 3 BörseG 2018 must tell the competent authority of the issuer's home member state within two trading days at the latest that it conducts or intends to conduct market making in that issuer, and tell it when it stops. Where the host member state requires a market making agreement, it must send the agreement to the FMA on request.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File major holding notifications through the FMA's web application and form
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Transparenz-Verordnung 2018 (TransV 2018), BGBl. II Nr. 392/2017, § 6, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: File major holding notifications through the FMA's web application and form

summaries.en: A notification to the Financial Market Authority under §§ 130 to 133 with § 134 Abs. 1 BörseG 2018 must be made through the web application on the FMA's website, which reproduces the annexed form. The notification to the issuer and the exchange operator uses the form the web application generates with the data of the notification.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify holdings of financial instruments within two trading days with the prescribed content
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Transparenz-Verordnung 2018 (TransV 2018), BGBl. II Nr. 392/2017, § 9 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Notify holdings of financial instruments within two trading days with the prescribed content

summaries.en: A notification of financial instruments under § 131 BörseG 2018 must state the resulting voting rights position, the chain of controlled undertakings where relevant, the date the threshold was reached or crossed, the exercise period, the maturity or expiry date, the holder and the issuer of the underlying shares. It is due within two trading days and goes to the issuer of the underlying shares, the Financial Market Authority and the exchange operator, separately for each issuer where an instrument refers to several shares.

instruments.title: Add VMV 2018, the FMA's regulation on disseminating regulated information and pre-notifying inside information (Verbreitungs- und Meldeverordnung 2018)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbreitungs- und Meldeverordnung 2018 (VMV 2018), BGBl. II Nr. 205/2017, made by the Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) under § 82 Abs. 7 BörseG (1989) and § 119 Abs. 6 und 7 BörseG 2018 (title document: long title, gazette reference, preamble, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, not amended since the original version; entry into force read in § 4 Abs. 1

titles.de: Verordnung der Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) über die Verbreitung vorgeschriebener Informationen und die Übermittlungen zu Meldungen gemäß Art. 17 der Verordnung (EU) Nr. 596/2014 über Marktmissbrauch (Verbreitungs- und Meldeverordnung 2018 – VMV 2018)
titles.en: Regulation of the Financial Market Authority (FMA) on the dissemination of regulated information and transmissions for disclosures under Article 17 of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 on market abuse (Dissemination and Notification Regulation 2018)

payload.officialRef: Verbreitungs- und Meldeverordnung 2018 (VMV 2018), BGBl. II Nr. 205/2017

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the advance notice of inside information in writing with the wording, time and a contact person
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbreitungs- und Meldeverordnung 2018 (VMV 2018), BGBl. II Nr. 205/2017, § 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Give the advance notice of inside information in writing with the wording, time and a contact person

summaries.en: The advance notice under § 119 Abs. 6 BörseG 2018 to the Financial Market Authority and the exchange operator must be made in writing and contain the wording of the publication under Article 17 of the Market Abuse Regulation, the exact planned time of publication and the name and telephone number of a contact person the issuer names.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Spread regulated information for the widest public access, including through a named news service
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbreitungs- und Meldeverordnung 2018 (VMV 2018), BGBl. II Nr. 205/2017, § 2 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Spread regulated information for the widest public access, including through a named news service

summaries.en: An issuer must spread regulated information in a way that gives investors the widest possible public access and as simultaneously as possible in the home member state and the other member states. The dissemination must in every case include publication through at least one of the electronic information systems Thomson Reuters, Bloomberg or Dow Jones Newswire.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send regulated information to the media in full, securely and with a clear header, and to the Kontrollbank, the FMA and the exchange
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Verbreitungs- und Meldeverordnung 2018 (VMV 2018), BGBl. II Nr. 205/2017, § 3 Abs. 2, 3, 5 und 6, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Send regulated information to the media in full, securely and with a clear header, and to the Kontrollbank, the FMA and the exchange

summaries.en: An issuer whose home member state is Austria must send regulated information to the media in full, or for annual and interim financial reports an announcement with the web address, and also to the Oesterreichische Kontrollbank, the Financial Market Authority and the exchange operator. It must transmit it securely, minimising corruption and unauthorised access and making the source certain, mark the subject, its name, the purpose of EU-wide dissemination and the time and date, and be able to tell the authority on request who transmitted it, the security measures, the time and the medium.

instruments.title: Add ZBMV, the FMA's regulation on payment service providers' statistical fraud reports (Zahlungsbetrugsmeldeverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Zahlungsbetrugsmeldeverordnung (ZBMV), BGBl. II Nr. 219/2022, made by the Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) under § 86 Abs. 4 ZaDiG 2018 (title document: long title, gazette reference, preamble, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, not amended since the original version; entry into force read in the RIS Inkrafttretensdatum of the original title document

titles.de: Verordnung der Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) über statistische Betrugsfallmeldungen durch Zahlungsdienstleister (Zahlungsbetrugsmeldeverordnung – ZBMV)
titles.en: Regulation of the Financial Market Authority (FMA) on statistical fraud reports by payment service providers (Payment Fraud Reporting Regulation)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report fraud statistics by payment instrument every half-year to the Nationalbank within two months
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Zahlungsbetrugsmeldeverordnung (ZBMV), BGBl. II Nr. 219/2022, § 1 Abs. 1 bis 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report fraud statistics by payment instrument every half-year to the Nationalbank within two months

summaries.en: A payment service provider must report statistical data on fraud connected with the different means of payment under § 86 Abs. 3 ZaDiG 2018, as at 30 June and 31 December, in the content and structure of the annex, and send them only to the Oesterreichische Nationalbank within two months of each reporting date. A provider that properly and fully files the payment statistics report under section 5 of the Nationalbank's data model regulation for the period meets this duty with it.

instruments.title: Add ZEIMV, the FMA's regulation on the periodic reports of payment and e-money institutions (Zahlungs- und E-Geld-Institute-Meldeverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Zahlungs- und E-Geld-Institute-Meldeverordnung (ZEIMV), BGBl. II Nr. 352/2009, made by the Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) under § 20 Abs. 5 of the Zahlungsdienstegesetz, BGBl. I Nr. 66/2009 (title document: long title, gazette reference, preamble, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, last amended by BGBl. II Nr. 328/2020; entry into force read in § 7 Abs. 1

titles.de: Verordnung der Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) zur Festlegung der Meldungen von Zahlungsinstituten und E-Geld-Instituten (Zahlungs- und E-Geld-Institute-Meldeverordnung – ZEIMV)
titles.en: Regulation of the Financial Market Authority (FMA) setting the reports of payment institutions and e-money institutions (Payment and E-Money Institutions Reporting Regulation)

payload.officialRef: Zahlungs- und E-Geld-Institute-Meldeverordnung (ZEIMV), BGBl. II Nr. 352/2009

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report balance sheet, income, safeguarding and organisation data each quarter by the tenth banking day
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Zahlungs- und E-Geld-Institute-Meldeverordnung (ZEIMV), BGBl. II Nr. 352/2009, § 1 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report balance sheet, income, safeguarding and organisation data each quarter by the tenth banking day

summaries.en: A payment institution or e-money institution must send the data of Anlage A1, in particular on its balance sheet, off-balance-sheet items, profit and loss account and notes, on credit granted, on the safeguarding of customer funds and on its organisational requirements, without delay after each calendar quarter and by the tenth banking day of the following month at the latest.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report own funds compliance data each month by the tenth banking day
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Zahlungs- und E-Geld-Institute-Meldeverordnung (ZEIMV), BGBl. II Nr. 352/2009, § 2 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report own funds compliance data each month by the tenth banking day

summaries.en: A payment institution or e-money institution must send the data of Anlage A2 on its compliance with the common equity tier 1 rules of §§ 16 and 17 ZaDiG 2018 or § 11 E-Geldgesetz 2010, with the figures from which they are derived, without delay after each calendar month and by the tenth banking day of the following month at the latest.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report master data changes at once, staff numbers by 31 January and confirm stored data each half-year
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Zahlungs- und E-Geld-Institute-Meldeverordnung (ZEIMV), BGBl. II Nr. 352/2009, § 3 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report master data changes at once, staff numbers by 31 January and confirm stored data each half-year

summaries.en: A payment institution or e-money institution must report its company master data as Anlage A3 requires and every change to them without delay, its number of staff at year end by 31 January of the following year, and confirm the correctness of the master data the Nationalbank holds by the 25th banking day of each following half-year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Repeat the year-end reports on audited figures within six months
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Zahlungs- und E-Geld-Institute-Meldeverordnung (ZEIMV), BGBl. II Nr. 352/2009, § 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Repeat the year-end reports on audited figures within six months

summaries.en: At the end of the financial year a payment institution or e-money institution must file the reports under Anlagen A1 and A2 both as §§ 1 and 2 require and on the basis of the figures the auditor has audited, the latter without delay and within six months of the end of the financial year at the latest.

instruments.title: Add InvF-LRMV, the FMA's regulation on liquidity risk management for UCITS (Investmentfonds-Liquiditätsrisikomanagementverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Investmentfonds-Liquiditätsrisikomanagementverordnung (InvF-LRMV), BGBl. II Nr. 117/2017, made by the Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) under § 87 Abs. 3 Z 3 InvFG 2011 (title document: long title, gazette reference, preamble, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, not amended since the original version; entry into force read in § 6

titles.de: Verordnung der Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) über den Risikomanagementprozess für Liquiditätsrisiken von Investmentfonds (Investmentfonds-Liquiditätsrisikomanagementverordnung – InvF-LRMV)
titles.en: Regulation of the Financial Market Authority (FMA) on the risk management process for liquidity risks of investment funds (Investment Funds Liquidity Risk Management Regulation)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a liquidity risk management process for each UCITS fitted to its strategy and redemption policy
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Investmentfonds-Liquiditätsrisikomanagementverordnung (InvF-LRMV), BGBl. II Nr. 117/2017, § 3 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Run a liquidity risk management process for each UCITS fitted to its strategy and redemption policy

summaries.en: A management company must set up for each UCITS a liquidity risk management process that reflects its investment strategy, liquidity profile and redemption policy. The process must at least keep the fund's liquidity appropriate to its liabilities based on an assessment of the assets' market liquidity, monitor the portfolio's liquidity profile and the investor base, and monitor the liquidity approach of other funds the UCITS invests in.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set liquidity limits for each UCITS, monitor them and fix the steps for a breach
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Investmentfonds-Liquiditätsrisikomanagementverordnung (InvF-LRMV), BGBl. II Nr. 117/2017, § 4 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Set liquidity limits for each UCITS, monitor them and fix the steps for a breach

summaries.en: A management company must set adequate limits for the liquidity or illiquidity of each UCITS in line with its liabilities, redemption policy and the risk limits of §§ 86 and 87 InvFG 2011, monitor compliance and lay down the steps to take when a limit is breached or about to be breached.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Stress test each UCITS's liquidity at least monthly and act on the results in the investors' best interest
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Investmentfonds-Liquiditätsrisikomanagementverordnung (InvF-LRMV), BGBl. II Nr. 117/2017, § 4 Abs. 3 und 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Stress test each UCITS's liquidity at least monthly and act on the results in the investors' best interest

summaries.en: A management company must run regular stress tests under normal and exceptional conditions to assess each UCITS's liquidity risks, based on reliable and current information, simulating illiquid assets and atypical redemptions and covering market risks and valuation sensitivities, at a frequency suited to the fund and at least monthly. It acts on the results in the best interest of the unit holders.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep each UCITS's asset liquidity consistent with its investment strategy and redemption policy
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Investmentfonds-Liquiditätsrisikomanagementverordnung (InvF-LRMV), BGBl. II Nr. 117/2017, § 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Keep each UCITS's asset liquidity consistent with its investment strategy and redemption policy

summaries.en: A management company must ensure that the liquidity profile of each UCITS's assets fits its investment strategy and redemption policy, so that unit holders can redeem fairly and in line with that policy, taking into account the effect redemptions may have on the prices or spreads of the assets.

instruments.title: Add AIFM-MV, the FMA's regulation on the reports of alternative investment fund managers (Alternative Investmentfonds Manager-Meldeverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Alternative Investmentfonds Manager-Meldeverordnung (AIFM-MV), BGBl. II Nr. 266/2015, made by the Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) under § 22 Abs. 9 AIFMG (title document: long title, gazette reference, preamble, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, last amended by BGBl. II Nr. 351/2019; entry into force read in § 5 Abs. 1

titles.de: Verordnung der Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) über die von Alternativen Investmentfonds Managern der FMA zu übermittelnden Meldungen (Alternative Investmentfonds Manager-Meldeverordnung – AIFM-MV)
titles.en: Regulation of the Financial Market Authority (FMA) on the reports alternative investment fund managers send to the FMA (AIFM Reporting Regulation)

payload.officialRef: Alternative Investmentfonds Manager-Meldeverordnung (AIFM-MV), BGBl. II Nr. 266/2015

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send the AIFM reports at the yearly, half-yearly or quarterly reporting dates within one month
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Alternative Investmentfonds Manager-Meldeverordnung (AIFM-MV), BGBl. II Nr. 266/2015, § 2 Abs. 1 bis 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Send the AIFM reports at the yearly, half-yearly or quarterly reporting dates within one month

summaries.en: An AIFM must send the reports under § 1 Abs. 5 Z 4 and § 22 AIFMG with the Delegated Regulation to the Financial Market Authority as at 31 December, as at 30 June and 31 December, or quarterly, as the provisions it falls under require, as soon as possible and within one month of the reporting date, extended by 15 days for a fund of funds. The duty starts with the quarter after its licensing or registration and, for each AIF, the quarter after its launch.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Add the national data on high-frequency trading, geographic split, hedging and risk measures to each report
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Alternative Investmentfonds Manager-Meldeverordnung (AIFM-MV), BGBl. II Nr. 266/2015, § 3 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Add the national data on high-frequency trading, geographic split, hedging and risk measures to each report

summaries.en: With each report an AIFM must add for every AIF it manages the number and market value of transactions made by high-frequency algorithmic trading, the geographic breakdown of investments and the share of the five main instruments used for hedging where short. Managers that report under § 22 Abs. 2 AIFMG add value at risk, vega exposure and the sensitivity to exchange rate and commodity price changes, and give reasons where a measure does not apply or is zero.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the AIFM reports in XML under the FMA's schema
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Alternative Investmentfonds Manager-Meldeverordnung (AIFM-MV), BGBl. II Nr. 266/2015, § 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: File the AIFM reports in XML under the FMA's schema

summaries.en: An AIFM must transmit the reports in XML format, prepared according to the XML Schema Definition the Financial Market Authority specifies.

instruments.title: Add BaSaPV, the FMA's regulation on the content and timing of banks' recovery plans (Bankensanierungsplanverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Bankensanierungsplanverordnung (BaSaPV), BGBl. II Nr. 25/2015, made by the Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) under § 4 Abs. 1 und 2 with § 4 Abs. 3 BaSAG (title document: long title, gazette reference, preamble, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, last amended by BGBl. II Nr. 98/2025; entry into force read in the RIS Inkrafttretensdatum of the original title document

titles.de: Verordnung der Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) über Inhalt und Detaillierungsgrad der Sanierungspläne von Banken (Bankensanierungsplanverordnung – BaSaPV)
titles.en: Regulation of the Financial Market Authority (FMA) on the content and level of detail of banks' recovery plans (Bank Recovery Plan Regulation)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Build the recovery plan with the scenarios and indicators the institution's category requires
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Bankensanierungsplanverordnung (BaSaPV), BGBl. II Nr. 25/2015, § 3 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Build the recovery plan with the scenarios and indicators the institution's category requires

summaries.en: A recovery plan or group recovery plan must meet §§ 8 to 10, 15 and 16 BaSAG and the annex to § 9 BaSAG with the simplifications of the paragraph. A category 1 institution includes a systemic scenario and the listed capital, leverage, liquidity, profitability and non-performing loan indicators; category 2 adds an idiosyncratic scenario; category 3 adds a combined scenario and a further profitability and asset quality indicator. CRR investment firms use the indicators set for them, and category 4 central institutions get no simplification.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the first recovery plan within six months of the licence and update it on the audited accounts
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Bankensanierungsplanverordnung (BaSaPV), BGBl. II Nr. 25/2015, § 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: File the first recovery plan within six months of the licence and update it on the audited accounts

summaries.en: An institution must draw up its first recovery plan and send it to the Financial Market Authority within six months of its licence becoming final. Once audited annual accounts exist, it updates the plan on those figures and sends it by 31 December after the end of the financial year, or by 30 September for category 4, and from then on updates it as § 5 requires.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Update and file the recovery plan every three, two or one years as the category requires
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Bankensanierungsplanverordnung (BaSaPV), BGBl. II Nr. 25/2015, § 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Update and file the recovery plan every three, two or one years as the category requires

summaries.en: Without prejudice to § 11 Abs. 1 second sentence BaSAG, an institution of category 1 must update its recovery plan and send it to the Financial Market Authority every three years by 31 December, categories 2 and 3 every two years by 31 December, and category 4 once a year by 30 September.

instruments.title: Add PB-MV, the FMA's regulation on covered bond issuers' quarterly reports (Pfandbrief-Meldeverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Pfandbrief-Meldeverordnung (PB-MV), BGBl. II Nr. 355/2022, made by the Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) under § 29 Abs. 2 PfandBG (title document: long title, gazette reference, preamble, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, last amended by BGBl. II Nr. 406/2022; entry into force read in § 10 Abs. 1

titles.de: Verordnung der Finanzmarktaufsichtsbehörde (FMA) über die Meldungen zum Pfandbriefgesetz (Pfandbrief-Meldeverordnung – PB-MV)
titles.en: Regulation of the Financial Market Authority (FMA) on reports under the Covered Bonds Act (Covered Bond Reporting Regulation)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report cover assets, cover requirements, the liquidity buffer and each covered bond as the annex requires
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Pfandbrief-Meldeverordnung (PB-MV), BGBl. II Nr. 355/2022, § 2 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report cover assets, cover requirements, the liquidity buffer and each covered bond as the annex requires

summaries.en: A credit institution established in Austria that has covered bonds outstanding must set out its reports as Anlage 1 requires: per cover pool the cover assets aggregated by instrument type, the cover requirements under § 9 PfandBG and the liquidity buffer under § 21 PfandBG, and information on each covered bond (§§ 6 to 8). It may leave out data it already reports under the GKE-V 2018 or the AnaCredit rules.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report as at each quarter end by the next quarterly reporting date
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Pfandbrief-Meldeverordnung (PB-MV), BGBl. II Nr. 355/2022, § 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report as at each quarter end by the next quarterly reporting date

summaries.en: The reporting date is the end of each quarter, and the reports are due by the following quarterly reporting date: 12 May, 11 August, 11 November or 11 February.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the covered bond reports electronically with the Nationalbank in the standard form
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Pfandbrief-Meldeverordnung (PB-MV), BGBl. II Nr. 355/2022, § 5 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: File the covered bond reports electronically with the Nationalbank in the standard form

summaries.en: The reports must be filed in standardised form by electronic transmission to the Oesterreichische Nationalbank, meeting the minimum requirements the Financial Market Authority announces after hearing the Nationalbank.

instruments.title: Add KontReg-DV, the Finance Minister's regulation on credit institutions' transmissions to the account register (Kontenregister-Durchführungsverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kontenregister-Durchführungsverordnung (KontReg-DV), BGBl. II Nr. 92/2016, made by the Bundesminister für Finanzen under § 3 Abs. 1 and § 6 KontRegG (title document: long title, gazette reference, preamble, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, last amended by BGBl. II Nr. 579/2020; entry into force read in the RIS Inkrafttretensdatum of the original title document

titles.de: Verordnung des Bundesministers für Finanzen zur Durchführung des Kontenregister- und Konteneinschaugesetzes (Kontenregister-Durchführungsverordnung – KontReg-DV)
titles.en: Regulation of the Federal Minister of Finance implementing the Account Register and Account Inspection Act (Account Register Implementing Regulation)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Transmit account register data through FinanzOnline by data stream or web service only
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kontenregister-Durchführungsverordnung (KontReg-DV), BGBl. II Nr. 92/2016, § 1 Abs. 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Transmit account register data through FinanzOnline by data stream or web service only

summaries.en: A credit institution must transmit its data to the account register electronically through FinanzOnline under the FinanzOnline Regulation 2006, and only by data stream transmission or a web service.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Name any service provider used for the transmission and report the end of the service at once
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kontenregister-Durchführungsverordnung (KontReg-DV), BGBl. II Nr. 92/2016, § 2 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Name any service provider used for the transmission and report the end of the service at once

summaries.en: A credit institution that uses a service provider, such as a data centre, for the transmission must name it to the Federal Minister of Finance, and must report the end of the service relationship to the Minister without delay and in the same way to the authority for the source PIN register and to Statistics Austria.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Transmit the account data with BIC and tax number, beneficial owners above 25 per cent and the trustors of new escrow accounts
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kontenregister-Durchführungsverordnung (KontReg-DV), BGBl. II Nr. 92/2016, § 3 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Transmit the account data with BIC and tax number, beneficial owners above 25 per cent and the trustors of new escrow accounts

summaries.en: A credit institution must transmit the data the Act lists, naming itself by its BIC and adding its tax number for identification in FinanzOnline. For joint accounts of co-owners and accounts of owners' communities it reports beneficial owners only where their share exceeds 25 per cent, and for escrow accounts opened after the register started it also reports the names of all trustors, except for pooled accounts of lawyers, notaries and public accountants and estate, guardianship and insolvency accounts.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record the identity of persons who present disposition slips for securities accounts
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kontenregister-Durchführungsverordnung (KontReg-DV), BGBl. II Nr. 92/2016, § 3 Abs. 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Record the identity of persons who present disposition slips for securities accounts

summaries.en: Where disposition slips are presented for instructions on securities accounts and business relationships under § 40 Abs. 5 first sentence BWG, the credit institution must record the identities of the persons presenting them in its existing electronic systems.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Transmit openings, closures and changes by the 25th of the following month and correct errors the same way
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kontenregister-Durchführungsverordnung (KontReg-DV), BGBl. II Nr. 92/2016, § 3 Abs. 6 Z 3 und 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Transmit openings, closures and changes by the 25th of the following month and correct errors the same way

summaries.en: A credit institution must transmit all changes in its data, and the opening and closing of accounts, by the 25th day of the following calendar month, or the next working day where the 25th falls on a Saturday, Sunday, public holiday or Good Friday. Changes and errors found in data already transmitted are corrected on the same terms.

instruments.title: Add 2. KontReg-DV, the Finance Minister's regulation on reporting credit accounts, payment accounts and safe deposit boxes to the account register (2. Kontenregister-Durchführungsverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), 2. Kontenregister-Durchführungsverordnung (2. KontReg-DV), BGBl. II Nr. 176/2021, made by the Bundesminister für Finanzen under § 3 Abs. 1b, 1c and § 6 KontRegG (title document: long title, gazette reference, preamble, amendments), read through the RIS open-data interface; consolidated text in force on 14 November 2026, not amended since the original version; entry into force read in the RIS Inkrafttretensdatum of the original title document

titles.de: 2. Verordnung des Bundesministers für Finanzen zur Durchführung des Kontenregister- und Konteneinschaugesetzes (2. Kontenregister-Durchführungsverordnung – 2. KontReg-DV)
titles.en: Second Regulation of the Federal Minister of Finance implementing the Account Register and Account Inspection Act (Second Account Register Implementing Regulation)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register for the transmissions where required and name any processor used
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), 2. Kontenregister-Durchführungsverordnung (2. KontReg-DV), BGBl. II Nr. 176/2021, § 2 Abs. 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Register for the transmissions where required and name any processor used

summaries.en: A commercial safe deposit box provider must register electronically on form Schliess 1 to obtain access to the account register. A credit or financial institution that uses a processor, such as a data centre, for the transmission must name it to the Federal Minister of Finance and report the end of the relationship without delay, credit institutions also to the authority for the source PIN register and to Statistics Austria.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Transmit credit account, payment account and safe deposit box data with the BIC by the 25th of the following month
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), 2. Kontenregister-Durchführungsverordnung (2. KontReg-DV), BGBl. II Nr. 176/2021, § 3 Abs. 1 bis 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Transmit credit account, payment account and safe deposit box data with the BIC by the 25th of the following month

summaries.en: A credit or financial institution must transmit the data the Act lists for credit accounts, payment accounts and safe deposit boxes through FinanzOnline, naming itself by its BIC and giving its tax number for identification. Changes, account openings and closures and the start and end of safe deposit box rentals are transmitted by the 25th of the following month, or the next working day after a weekend, public holiday or Good Friday, and corrections on the same terms. Under Abs. 5 trustors of escrow accounts under simplified due diligence need not be reported.

instruments.title: Add KapAbfl-DV, the Finance Minister's regulation on reporting capital outflows and inflows (Kapitalabfluss-Durchführungsverordnung)

titles.de: Verordnung des Bundesministers für Finanzen zur Durchführung des Kapitalabfluss-Meldegesetzes (Kapitalabfluss-Durchführungsverordnung – KapAbfl-DV)
titles.en: Regulation of the Federal Minister of Finance implementing the Capital Outflow Reporting Act (Capital Outflow Implementing Regulation)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Transmit capital flow reports through FinanzOnline by data stream or web service only
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kapitalabfluss-Durchführungsverordnung (KapAbfl-DV), BGBl. II Nr. 91/2016, § 1 Abs. 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Transmit capital flow reports through FinanzOnline by data stream or web service only

summaries.en: A credit institution or payment institution must transmit its reports under the Capital Outflow Reporting Act electronically through FinanzOnline under the FinanzOnline Regulation 2006, and only by data stream transmission or a web service. Under § 2 it names any service provider it uses and reports the end of that service without delay.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report capital outflows and inflows with the prescribed data, counting free-delivery securities transfers as outflows
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kapitalabfluss-Durchführungsverordnung (KapAbfl-DV), BGBl. II Nr. 91/2016, § 3 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report capital outflows and inflows with the prescribed data, counting free-delivery securities transfers as outflows

summaries.en: A credit or payment institution must transmit the data the Act lists for outflows and inflows, the amount included, with its BIC, its tax number and, for asset-managing partnerships, the firm name. A transfer of securities to another owner in Austria by free delivery is a reportable outflow unless it is a transfer between the owner's own accounts. Inflows below 50,000 euros from Switzerland or Liechtenstein to an Austrian account must be checked against inflows to a depot of the same holder, and inflows left after a one-off payment are reported even below 50,000 euros.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Add up linked outflows per quarter and treat them as made at quarter end once they reach 50,000 euros
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Kapitalabfluss-Durchführungsverordnung (KapAbfl-DV), BGBl. II Nr. 91/2016, § 3 Abs. 5 Z 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Add up linked outflows per quarter and treat them as made at quarter end once they reach 50,000 euros

summaries.en: Outflows that form a linked transaction under the Act must be added up per calendar quarter and count, in the whole added amount, as made at the end of the quarter in which the sum first or again reaches 50,000 euros.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the statistical reports electronically in German under the Nationalbank's standards and correct them at once
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Meldeverordnung ZABIL 1/2022 der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank, BGBl. II Nr. 573/2020, § 3 Abs. 1, 2, 5, 6 und 10, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: File the statistical reports electronically in German under the Nationalbank's standards and correct them at once

summaries.en: A reporting agent must file reports and master data electronically under the technical standards the Oesterreichische Nationalbank publishes on its website, in German, with all contents of one survey and period in a single report and the master data sent and updated in time before the report. Where a filed report needs to be corrected, completed or cut back, it must file a corrected report without delay.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report direct investment transactions of 500,000 euros or more by the 15th of the following month
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Meldeverordnung ZABIL 1/2022 der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank, BGBl. II Nr. 573/2020, § 10, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report direct investment transactions of 500,000 euros or more by the 15th of the following month

summaries.en: A resident that makes or receives direct investments, or holds or receives holdings below 10 per cent other than shares, must report each cross-border transaction of at least 500,000 euros (§ 9), and every transaction that ends a reported direct investment, by the 15th calendar day of the month after the month in which ownership passed, or for profit distributions the month of payment.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report loans and deposits with foreign group companies and the additional data each month by the tenth banking day
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Meldeverordnung ZABIL 1/2022 der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank, BGBl. II Nr. 573/2020, § 17 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report loans and deposits with foreign group companies and the additional data each month by the tenth banking day

summaries.en: A deposit-taking institution with its seat or a branch in Austria must report, without a threshold, its loans and deposits with foreign creditors and debtors in a direct investment relationship, other than foreign monetary financial institutions and banks, broken down as Anlage B.1 requires and with the holdings defined as in its VERA-V asset statement, and the additional data in Anlage B.2. Both reports are due monthly by the tenth banking day of the following month, with the month end as reporting date.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report cross-border derivative payments and positions monthly by the 15th once they reach 1 million euros
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Meldeverordnung ZABIL 1/2022 der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank, BGBl. II Nr. 573/2020, § 25 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report cross-border derivative payments and positions monthly by the 15th once they reach 1 million euros

summaries.en: A resident that deals in financial derivatives with non-residents must report its cross-border payments in and out and its positions each month by the 15th calendar day of the following month, as Anlage D requires, once the net payments of a month or the positions at month end reach 1 million euros (§ 24). When both fall back below the threshold it files a final nil report.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report own securities holdings and securities kept for others security by security with the ISIN
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Meldeverordnung ZABIL 1/2022 der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank, BGBl. II Nr. 573/2020, § 26 Abs. 1 bis 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report own securities holdings and securities kept for others security by security with the ISIN

summaries.en: Under § 27 a monetary financial institution other than a money market fund, and any resident that keeps or manages securities for others, must report its own securities holdings wherever held and the transactions and holdings of securities it keeps or manages for others, as Anlage E requires, security by security with the ISIN or with master data where there is none, in euros and the nominal currency, and a holding value, zero included, for every record that showed a holding in the previous period. Under § 29 the report is due monthly by the 15th calendar day, for monetary financial institutions by the tenth banking day.

titles.de: Verordnung der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank betreffend die Erfassung von Kredit- und Länderrisiken, Restlaufzeiten und Fremdwährungskrediten sowie Finanzinformationen von Auslandstochterbanken (Meldeverordnung FinStab 2024)
titles.en: Regulation of the Oesterreichische Nationalbank on the recording of credit and country risks, residual maturities and foreign currency loans and financial information of foreign subsidiary banks (FinStab Reporting Regulation 2024)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report residual maturities and foreign currency loans each quarter by the twentieth banking day
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Meldeverordnung FinStab 2024, BGBl. II Nr. 87/2024, § 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report residual maturities and foreign currency loans each quarter by the twentieth banking day

summaries.en: A credit institution that takes deposits or other repayable funds from the public and grants credit for its own account must report information on residual maturities and foreign currency loans on an individual basis to the Oesterreichische Nationalbank, structured as Beilage A1 requires. Under §§ 7 and 8 the reporting dates are the quarter ends and the report is due by the twentieth banking day after each.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report unconsolidated credit risk information each quarter by the fortieth banking day
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Meldeverordnung FinStab 2024, BGBl. II Nr. 87/2024, § 2, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report unconsolidated credit risk information each quarter by the fortieth banking day

summaries.en: A deposit-taking credit institution must report its credit risk information to the Nationalbank as Beilage A2 requires, by the fortieth banking day after each quarter end (§ 8). A parent institution or central organisation that reports consolidated risk under § 4 is exempt, and so is an institution whose parent or central organisation reports under § 4.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report unconsolidated country risk where foreign exposures exceed 100 million euros
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Meldeverordnung FinStab 2024, BGBl. II Nr. 87/2024, § 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report unconsolidated country risk where foreign exposures exceed 100 million euros

summaries.en: A deposit-taking credit institution must report its country risk information on an individual basis as Beilage A3 requires, by the fortieth banking day after each quarter end (§ 8). The duty falls away where its original foreign exposures under the supervisory reporting standards do not exceed 100 million euros on the last audited accounts, and on the same group exemptions as for credit risk.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the group's consolidated country and credit risk where its foreign exposures exceed 100 million euros
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Meldeverordnung FinStab 2024, BGBl. II Nr. 87/2024, § 4, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report the group's consolidated country and credit risk where its foreign exposures exceed 100 million euros

summaries.en: The parent institution of a banking group, or the central organisation of an association of credit institutions, must report country and credit risk information for the group or association as Beilage B requires, consolidated under the CRR method at the level of the parent, by the fortieth banking day after each quarter end (§ 8). The duty falls away where the group's original foreign exposures do not exceed 100 million euros on the last audited consolidated accounts.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report financial information on each foreign deposit-taking subsidiary bank on an individual basis
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Meldeverordnung FinStab 2024, BGBl. II Nr. 87/2024, § 5, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report financial information on each foreign deposit-taking subsidiary bank on an individual basis

summaries.en: The parent institution of a banking group must report, under § 6, financial information on each deposit-taking credit institution in the group, and on their own such subsidiaries, on an individual basis, using the supervisory financial reporting templates § 6 names. Under § 8 the reports are due by 12 May, 11 August, 11 November and 11 February.

titles.de: Verordnung der Oesterreichischen Nationalbank betreffend die Übermittlung von Meldedaten an die Oesterreichische Nationalbank unter Anwendung eines Datenmodells (Datenmodellverordnung 2024)
titles.en: Regulation of the Oesterreichische Nationalbank on transmitting reporting data to the Oesterreichische Nationalbank using a data model (Data Model Regulation 2024)

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the reports electronically in the Nationalbank's data model format as the annexes structure them
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Datenmodellverordnung 2024, BGBl. II Nr. 88/2024, § 1, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: File the reports electronically in the Nationalbank's data model format as the annexes structure them

summaries.en: A reporting agent must file the reports due under sections 2 to 7 of the regulation electronically to the Oesterreichische Nationalbank in the technical reporting format of the data model, which records single transactions with descriptive attributes, structured by the business types, attributes and value types the annexes set out.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report credit data in the cubes that match the institution's reporting groups
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Datenmodellverordnung 2024, BGBl. II Nr. 88/2024, § 3, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report credit data in the cubes that match the institution's reporting groups

summaries.en: A deposit-taking institution resident in Austria must report credit data in the data model, for the ECB's monetary and interest rate statistics and the Nationalbank's financial stability and capital flow reports that § 2 lists, in the credit cube of § 4 that matches its reporting groups. §§ 6 and 9 set the same duty for its deposit, general ledger and securities data.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report granular credit data on instruments, collateral, balance sheet and risk as the annexes require
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Datenmodellverordnung 2024, BGBl. II Nr. 88/2024, § 16, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report granular credit data on instruments, collateral, balance sheet and risk as the annexes require

summaries.en: A CRR credit institution resident in Austria, and an Austrian branch of one from another member state, must report the granular credit data due under the GKE-V 2018 and the AnaCredit rules as Beilagen B1 (instrument, financial and collateral data) and B2 (balance sheet and risk data) require, using the code values of Beilage B5; CRR financial institutions report under Beilagen B3 and B4.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report payment statistics quarterly and half-yearly as the payment statistics annexes require
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Datenmodellverordnung 2024, BGBl. II Nr. 88/2024, § 13 lit. a, c, d und e, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Report payment statistics quarterly and half-yearly as the payment statistics annexes require

summaries.en: A payment service provider resident in Austria must report payment statistics as the annexes require: as issuer or acquirer quarterly under Beilage Da, half-yearly payment data and payment fraud data under Beilagen Dc and Dd, and transfers, direct debits and cheques quarterly under Beilage De. Under § 21 lit. g quarterly reports are due 20 banking days and half-yearly reports two months after the period.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Meet the data model deadlines of 10, 20 or 40 banking days and the quarterly reporting dates
obligations.sourceLabel: Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (RIS), Datenmodellverordnung 2024, BGBl. II Nr. 88/2024, § 21 lit. a bis e, consolidated text read through the RIS open-data interface

titles.en: Meet the data model deadlines of 10, 20 or 40 banking days and the quarterly reporting dates

summaries.en: The monthly credit, deposit and securities reports in the monetary statistics cubes are due 10 banking days after the reporting date, the quarterly financial stability cubes 20 or 40 banking days after it, the granular instrument data 20 banking days after it, and the granular balance sheet and risk data by the next quarterly reporting date: 12 May, 11 August, 11 November or 11 February.
